- type: data_issue
  description: The Planner in step 5 incorrectly extracted the year for 3.2.1. as 2018 instead of 1998 from the WebSurfer results, leading to a false conclusion that Issa Album (2017) came first, when 3.2.1. (1998) actually came first.
  severity: 0.90
  if_from_wrong: If the date extraction in S2 had been correct (1998), the comparison in S2 would have correctly identified 3.2.1. as the earlier album.
  likely_effect_on_to: The final answer would be incorrect ("Issa Album came out first" instead of "3.2.1.").
